Regression: cardiology Parametri tab (pressure 140/85, FC, SpO2 units), 1200 sistolica plausibility Confermo/Correggi; pediatric editor tabs incl. Crescita, Esame obiettivo generale + TORL. Giulia Demo gyn visit still guardian_hidden true, tutore portal 0 reports.

minor.issue: visit_setup(module_id) validation runs AFTER the live chunked transcript is consumed and db.live_sessions deleted (and after audio part lookup). If module_id is rejected (400) the live transcript is lost. Move the visit_setup/module validation before live_transcript consumption.

Secondary specialties without a dedicated module (e.g. Neurologia) collapse silently into 'Generale' with specialita = MAIN specialty, so a Neurology visit is structured by the LLM as e.g. 'Cardiologia' and labeled 'Generale'. Consider specialita of the secondary or offering one option per secondary specialty.

issues: consult-module-select has near-invisible text: computed color rgb(247,249,251) on background rgb(228,234,236) (~1.1:1 contrast). 'Cardiologia' is barely readable. Use dark text on the light pill or a dark bg in the overlay theme.
Missing main specialty error reads 'Specializzazione: almeno 2 caratteri' (length message on a select) - should be e.g. 'Scelga la specializzazione principale'.
Specialty select uses bg-[var(--raised)] (white-ish) while other inputs are grey - slight inconsistency.
Transient: tabs render 4 base tabs first then switch to 6 module tabs once catalog loads (brief flicker).
